# AFAGHX Pull Request

## Purpose

Describe the architectural or product change and its ownership boundary.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added/updated where applicable
- [ ] Contract compatibility checked
- [ ] Tenant isolation considered
- [ ] Security implications reviewed
- [ ] Secrets/configuration checked
- [ ] Migration rollback considered if applicable
- [ ] ADR added/updated if an irreversible architectural decision is introduced

## Review

Do not merge changes that bypass AFX-CORE security context, violate dependency direction, or introduce undocumented cross-domain coupling.
